subject: Interpreting lines that lead way off a spatial encounter history plot

messages.author: 352904662ed7b7cc
messages.subject: Interpreting lines that lead way off a spatial encounter history plot
parts:
All,

I'm curious as to why the lines are pointing way off the attached spatial encounter history plot. Because they are almost parallel, it would appear the spatial average of this one animal would be way outside the trapping grid, yet it was captured at two different traps during the session. This pattern does not occur for other sessions. Any thoughts on this?

Thanks,

Alexej
